# AdventureWorks

> End-to-end Azure demo built on the AdventureWorks sample database: a React storefront, admin portal and manufacturing portal backed by Data API builder (GraphQL/REST/MCP), .NET Azure Functions on Flex Consumption, a self-contained OAuth 2.1 + MCP server (api-mcp, 63 tools), Microsoft Foundry agents plus a hosted Manufacturing agent, Azure SQL over private networking and Web PubSub real-time push, deployed with `azd up`. Demo/POC only; environments are disposable.

Start with README.md and QUICKSTART.md. Use docs/glossary.md for terminology. Agents editing the repository must follow .github/copilot-instructions.md.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): Landing page — what the demo is, feature tour, architecture diagram, azd services and deploy pointer.
- [Quickstart](QUICKSTART.md): Deploy with azd up, monitor the async seed job, sign in as Ken or Peter, clean up.
- [Documentation hub](docs/README.md): Index of every documentation page grouped by topic.
- [Glossary](docs/glossary.md): Definitions of DAB, OAuth, MCP, agent, manufacturing, order status and deployment terms.

## Architecture

- [System overview](docs/architecture/system-overview.md): Components, hosting and how they connect end to end.
- [Request flows](docs/architecture/request-flows.md): Sequence diagrams for sign-in, checkout, order processing and agent runs.
- [Real-time eventing](docs/architecture/realtime-eventing.md): Web PubSub push, SQL outbox listener and polling-free frontends.
- [Data stores](docs/architecture/data-stores.md): Azure SQL schema, Storage queues/tables/blobs and Durable Functions state.
- [Identity and authentication](docs/architecture/identity-and-auth.md): Managed identities, OAuth resource tokens, scopes, roles and categories.
- [AI architecture](docs/architecture/ai-architecture.md): Foundry models, prompt agents, hosted agent and MCP tools.
- [Networking](docs/architecture/networking.md): Virtual network, subnets, private endpoints and public ingress.
- [DAB naming conventions](docs/architecture/dab-naming-conventions.md): How database tables map to DAB GraphQL and REST names.
- [Reference architecture diagram](docs/AdventureWorks-Reference-Architecture.svg): SVG diagram of the Azure services and how they connect.
- [Demo recording (GIF)](docs/adventureworks-demo.gif) and [demo recording (WebM)](docs/adventureworks-demo.webm): Short screen recording of the storefront and portals.

## Apps

- [Storefront](docs/apps/storefront.md): Public React SPA on Static Web Apps — catalog, cart, checkout, AI search and chat.
- [Admin portal](docs/apps/admin-portal.md): Back-office React app on Container Apps for employees.
- [Manufacturing portal](docs/apps/manufacturing-portal.md): Seven-stage production and supply-chain React app for manufacturing staff.
- [MCP Inspector](docs/apps/mcp-inspector.md): Hosted MCP Inspector for exploring api-mcp and DAB MCP tools.

## Features: commerce

- [Catalog and browsing](docs/features/commerce/catalog-and-browsing.md): Categories, product pages, sale, compare and recently viewed.
- [Cart and checkout](docs/features/commerce/cart-and-checkout.md): Guest and signed-in carts, merge, checkout and order creation.
- [Order lifecycle](docs/features/commerce/order-lifecycle.md): Simulated order statuses 1–7, pipeline timing and delivery.
- [Receipts](docs/features/commerce/receipts.md): PDF receipt generation, private blob storage and download.
- [Promotions](docs/features/promotions/promotions.md): Special offers, AI-generated promotions and auto-promotions.
- [SEO](docs/features/seo/seo.md): Meta tags, structured data, robots.txt and sitemap.

## Features: customers

- [Accounts and sign-in](docs/features/customers/accounts-and-sign-in.md): Consumer sign-up, sign-in, profile, addresses and payment methods.
- [Passwords and reset](docs/features/customers/passwords-and-reset.md): Password hashing, change and reset flow.
- [Email notifications](docs/features/email/email-notifications.md): Order confirmation, shipped/delivered and admin emails via Azure Communication Services.
- [Localization](docs/features/i18n/localization.md): 23 storefront languages, AI translation and currencies.

## Features: content and AI

- [Foundry agents](docs/features/ai/foundry-agents.md): Catalog of Foundry agents, their tools and callers.
- [AI chat](docs/features/ai/ai-chat.md): Storefront shopping assistant and admin business assistant.
- [AI content generation](docs/features/ai/ai-content-generation.md): AI product copy, images, customers, categories and translations.
- [Product reviews](docs/features/reviews/product-reviews.md): Reviews, AI generation, verified reviews and moderation.
- [Semantic search](docs/features/search/semantic-search.md): Vector search and suggestions over Azure SQL embeddings.
- [Help me choose](docs/features/search/help-me-choose.md): AI questionnaire that recommends products using MCP catalog tools.

## Features: manufacturing and supply

- [Manufacturing overview](docs/features/manufacturing/manufacturing-overview.md): Seven-stage model, products, BOMs and routings.
- [Production simulation](docs/features/manufacturing/production-simulation.md): Work-order operations, scrap, workforce and timing.
- [Planning and feasibility](docs/features/manufacturing/planning-and-feasibility.md): Demand, shortages, feasibility, costing and reorder advice.
- [Manufacturing content](docs/features/manufacturing/manufacturing-content.md): AI assembly instructions, diagrams and part sheets with illustrations.
- [Manufacturing agent](docs/features/manufacturing/manufacturing-agent.md): Agent modes, runs, proposals and approvals.
- [Supply chain](docs/features/supply-chain/supply-chain.md): Vendors, quotes, purchase orders and receiving.
- [Warehouse operations](docs/features/warehouse/warehouse-operations.md): Simulated store, retrieve and receive operations with damage.

## Features: simulators and finance

- [Shopping simulator](docs/features/simulators/shopping-simulator.md): AI-generated consumer and B2B orders with auto-stop.
- [Simulator controls](docs/features/simulators/simulator-controls.md): Start, stop, reset and tune the simulations.
- [Bank simulator](docs/features/finance/bank-simulator.md): Simulated accounts and transactions driven by orders and purchases.
- [Reporting](docs/features/finance/reporting.md): Sales, profitability, inventory and customer reports.

## Security and identity

- [MCP OAuth](docs/features/mcp-oauth/README.md): api-mcp authorization server, clients, grants and resource-bound tokens.
- [MCP tool scope matrix](docs/features/mcp-oauth/TOOL_SCOPE_MATRIX.md): Required scope and access rules for each MCP tool.
- [Functions OAuth](docs/features/functions-oauth/README.md): How Functions validates tokens, scopes, categories and ownership.
- [Functions route scope matrix](docs/features/functions-oauth/ROUTE_SCOPE_MATRIX.md): Authorization tier and scope for every Functions HTTP route.
- [End-to-end authentication](docs/features/authentication/END_TO_END_AUTHENTICATION.md): Trust model and executable validation across all services.

## Services

- [Data API builder](docs/services/dab-api.md): DAB GraphQL, REST and MCP over Azure SQL with role permissions.
- [Azure Functions](docs/services/functions.md): Flex Consumption app — triggers, scaling, configuration and structure.
- [api-mcp](docs/services/api-mcp.md): OAuth authorization server and MCP server with 63 tools.
- [Hosted Manufacturing agent](docs/services/manufacturing-agent.md): Foundry hosted agent, identity and MCP tool access.
- [Seed job](docs/services/seed-job.md): Container Apps job that loads data, images and demo extensions.

## Operations

- [Deployment](docs/operations/deployment.md): azd lifecycle, hooks and redeploying service changes.
- [Deployer permissions](docs/AZD_DEPLOYER_PERMISSIONS.md): Why Contributor is not enough and the conditioned role-assignment grant.
- [CI/CD](docs/operations/ci-cd.md): GitHub Actions workflows for build checks and service-principal deployment.
- [Dev container](docs/operations/dev-container.md): Dev container tooling and the deploy-and-test-in-Azure workflow.
- [WSL deployment](docs/operations/wsl-deployment.md): Deploying from Windows Subsystem for Linux.
- [Monitoring](docs/operations/monitoring.md): Application Insights telemetry across frontends, Functions, api-mcp, Inspector and seed job: custom events (including Sql.SessionPrincipal identity evidence), sampling, trace correlation and KQL queries.
- [Health diagnostics](docs/features/monitoring/HEALTH_DIAGNOSTICS.md): Readiness endpoints and the storefront /health page.
- [Seed data generation](docs/operations/seed-data-generation.md): Exporting embeddings and translations into seed CSVs.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/operations/troubleshooting.md): Common deployment and runtime problems and their fixes.
